metadata.layer_official_name: Candidate Bathymetric Screening Polygons for Voluntary Shark Bycatch Review
metadata.depth_range_criteria: Continental Slope 200 - 1000 m (within 150 - 1200 m screening envelope) intersected with seasonal upwelling cooling SST <= 26.0 °C
metadata.bathymetry_source: GEBCO 2023 Grid & NOAA ETOPO1 Bedrock (multi-source composite without single uniform vertical datum)
metadata.thermocline_definition: Vertical thermal gradient / subsurface thermocline interaction (separated from surface upwelling indicators)
metadata.upwelling_indicator: SST Contrast (ΔT coast-offshore) and Meridional Ekman Transport (Mey)
metadata.taxonomic_uncertainty_notes: Recorded only at genus level (Carcharhinus spp.) in PPN Prigi port landings. Cannot be differentiated between C. falciformis (CITES Appendix II) or C. longimanus (CITES Appendix I effective 2026-03-05) without morphological inspection or molecular barcoding.
metadata.cites_appendix: Appendix II (Family Carcharhinidae spp. listing; with Appendix I exception for Carcharhinus longimanus)
metadata.cites_taxonomic_scope: Family Carcharhinidae spp. included in CITES Appendix II except species listed in Appendix I (Carcharhinus longimanus transferred to Appendix I effective 2026-03-05); genus-level port records require species-level diagnostic verification.
metadata.cites_verification_source: CITES Notification to the Parties No. 2026/015 (Appendices valid from 5 March 2026)
metadata.scientific_caveat: These 123 polygons represent candidate bathymetric and thermal screening areas for voluntary shark bycatch review. They are derived from seafloor depth and surface cooling proxies, NOT verified empirical shark catch locations or regulatory closures.
